title: Creator Content & Sponsorship Worksheets
subtitle: Planning pages for a creator workflow; do not use as a substitute for a contract or accounting records

pages.title: 1. Weekly publishing plan
pages.intro: Turn an idea into a deliverable with a channel, owner and review date. Keep the plan realistic for the time you actually have.
checks: The audience and purpose for each planned post are clear.
Production, editing, approval and publishing dates are separated.
Dependencies such as products, access, music or review approval are recorded.
At least one buffer slot is left for delays or timely opportunities.

pages.title: 2. Sponsorship campaign brief
pages.intro: Record the agreed scope before work begins. Confirm usage, revisions and payment terms in the signed agreement with the brand.
checks: Deliverables and platforms match the written agreement.
Draft, approval and publication dates are confirmed.
Usage period, paid amplification and exclusivity are explicitly addressed.
Disclosure requirements and the approval contact are documented.
Fee, invoice date, payment due date and late-payment contact are captured.

pages.title: 3. Invoice and usage-rights close-out
pages.intro: Use this at delivery so the work, payment and permitted use do not disappear into old messages.
checks: Final deliverables and live links have been sent and acknowledged.
Invoice reference, issue date, due date and payment status are logged.
Any changes to the brief or extra revisions have written approval.
The rights-expiry or renewal date is calendared for follow-up.
The project files and agreement are stored in the agreed archive.
